title: cynanchum cyathiforme
intro: Cynanchum cyathiforme, commonly known as the "Chinese bugbane", is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum cyathiforme include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and cardiovascular protective effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. These constituents are also believed to exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities.
